crossRefs.note: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

translations.web: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.
translations.bsb: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached at two of its corners, so it could be fastened.
translations.kjv: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
translations.asv: They made shoulder-pieces for it, joined together; at the two ends was it joined together.
